summary: `train.qlora` — QLoRA/LoRA fine-tune through the proven train bodies: the hermetic stub under `stub`, else the local trainer on real CUDA. Writes train_result.json for the stages after it; returns the run's scalars. 1.1.0: the governed train/eval/test splits (train_uri, eval_uri, test_uri) and the batch, accumulation, checkpointing and dropout knobs; `extra` is not part of the configuration.
